per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC NULLS LAST
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "fd"."name"
FROM "cards" "c"
INNER JOIN "sets" "s" ON "c"."setcode" = "s"."code"
INNER JOIN "foreign_data" "fd" ON "c"."uuid" = "fd"."uuid"
WHERE "s"."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND "fd"."language" = 'Italian'
ORDER BY "c"."convertedmanacost" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of the cards with a converted mana cost of 7 in the set Coldsnap?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN "convertedmanacost" = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC * 100.0) / 
    COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS "percentage"
FROM "cards"
JOIN "sets" ON "cards"."setcode" = "sets"."code"
WHERE "sets"."name" = 'Coldsnap'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT T1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL AND NOT T1.cardKingdomId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'
per_case_results.actual_sql:

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL AND "cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)

WHERE "setcode" IN (SELECT "code" FROM "sets" WHERE "name" = 'Coldsnap')

per_case_results.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
per_case_results.expected_sql: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "l"."format", "c"."name"
FROM "legalities" "l"
INNER JOIN "cards" "c" ON "l"."id" = "c"."id"
WHERE "l"."status" = 'Banned'
AND "l"."format" = (
    SELECT "format"
    FROM "legalities" "l2"
    INNER JOIN "cards" "c2" ON "l2"."id" = "c2"."id"
    WHERE "l2"."status" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "format"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY "c"."name"

per_case_results.question: Which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec? List all of the cards name and its banned play format.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.edhrecRank = 1 AND T2.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.format
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "cards"."name", "legalities"."format"
FROM "cards"
INNER JOIN "legalities" ON "cards"."uuid" = "legalities"."uuid"
WHERE "cards"."edhrecrank" = 1
AND "legalities"."status" = 'Banned'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, CASE WHEN T1.status = 'Legal' THEN T1.format ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T2.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT "cards"."name", "legalities"."format"
FROM "cards"
INNER JOIN "sets" ON "cards"."setcode" = "sets"."code"
INNER JOIN "legalities" ON "cards"."id" = "legalities"."id"
WHERE "sets"."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
ORDER BY "cards"."name", "legalities"."format"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM sets WHERE code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean' AND NOT language LIKE '%Japanese%')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name"
FROM "sets" "s"
INNER JOIN "set_translations" "st" ON "st"."setcode" = "s"."code"
WHERE "st"."language" = 'Korean'
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "set_translations" "st_jp"
    WHERE "st_jp"."setcode" = "s"."code"
    AND "st_jp"."language" LIKE '%Japanese%'
)
LIMIT 500
